note: Approximate outing forecast, not a personal exposure or risk estimate.

profileMessages.belowThresholdHeadline: No covered period in this outing reaches UV Index 3.
profileMessages.elevatedHeadline: UV Index 3 or higher is forecast for about {duration} of the covered outing.
profileMessages.explanation: The guidance considers both UV level and time spent at each level, not just the peak.
profileMessages.lowUvContext: The covered forecast stays below UV Index 3, the usual threshold for sun-protection advice. This does not mean zero UV; reflective surroundings and personal circumstances are not included.
profileMessages.reflectiveConditions: If your outing is near snow, bright sand, or water, keep protecting yourself even in shade—reflected UV can add exposure.
profileMessages.sunscreenAfterConditions: If you use sunscreen, reapply after swimming, sweating, or drying off; follow the product label.
profileMessages.sunscreenExtendedExposure: The forecast has about {duration} at UV Index 3 or higher, across {periods}. If you use sunscreen, plan to reapply during this extended elevated-UV time; WHO recommends every two hours and particularly after swimming, sweating, or drying off. Follow the product label. UV Scout does not know when you applied it.
profileMessages.moderateAction: For about {duration} at UV Index 3 to below 8 ({periods}), cover exposed skin with clothing, wear a broad-brimmed hat and UV-protective sunglasses, and use available shade when UV is strongest.
profileMessages.veryHighAction: The outing has about {duration} at UV Index 8+ ({periods}). If possible, plan to spend these forecast hours in shade. Shade is not complete protection, so keep covering up and protect your eyes.
profileMessages.sunscreenBasics: For skin left uncovered, use broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen. Apply it generously and evenly as the label directs. Sunscreen is one layer of protection, not a reason to stay outside longer.
profileMessages.cloudyElevatedUv: Although very cloudy conditions are forecast, UV Index 3+ is also forecast during {periods}. Clouds can reduce UV, but do not reliably remove it; follow the UV Index forecast rather than cloud cover alone.
profileMessages.average: Across the covered part of the outing: {averageUv}.

messages.coverageIncomplete: The forecast covers about {coveredDuration} of this {plannedDuration} outing. Conditions during the uncovered part are unknown.
